For Petitioner : Mr. K.R.Laxman  For Respondents  For RR1 & 3 : Mr.S.Shanmuga Vel,
 Additional Government Plea
For R2 : Mr.Lawrance  For R4 : Ms.M.Aasha  Government Advocate  For R5 : Mr.M.Rajarajan  ORDER

The present writ petition is filed for Mandamus directing the respondents no.1 to 4 to forthwith enforce closure of the Butcher Shop / Motton Stall of the 5th respondent, pursuant to the cancellation of the license dated 25.02.2022, under proceeding No.Nil passed by the 2nd respondent and cancellation of license dated 18.11.2022 under proceeding Na.Ka. No.2308/2022 passed by the 3rd respondent, and ensure the 4th respondent does not remain as an unlawful occupant upon the shop under _____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 13/06/2025 11:40:06 am ) T.S.No.203, D.No.110, West Car Street, Dindigul, by considering the representation dated 31.12.2024.
2.
The petitioner is the owner of the land and the 5th respondent is running a Butcher Shop in the said land.
Admittedly, there is a tenancy dispute between the petitioner and the 5th respondent.
The petitioner has converted the writ jurisdiction under Article 226 of Constitution of India as rent control, which cannot be entertained.
Hence, this Writ Petition is dismissed.
However, if there is any violation, as per the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the Urban Local Body Act, the 2nd and 3rd respondent may act in accordance with law.
Consequently, connected writ miscellaneous petition is closed.
No costs.
